## 1.3.35 (HexGhoul): random colours for every path: Ukaku's wings, their crystal forms and every shard in your kagune's colour; wild ghouls get random kagune colours too (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.35 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 66**, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, wing colours checked in offline renders, **not tried in game**.

- **Ukaku follows your colour too.** The colour you rolled in 1.3.34 (`/kagune color`, `/kagune color reroll`) now also colours the Ukaku path: both wing forms (gaseous and crystal), the Black Rabbit's one wing, the kakuja armour, every shard and crystal spike it fires, the wing vortex, crystal thorns, and the spikes left stuck in bodies (remembered as whoever shot them). The whole red palette is turned to your hue, so the depths stay darker and the rims and glow lighter. The rare near-black is black crystal with a blood-red glow. Bone white is pale ash and bone. The default crimson looks exactly as before.
- **Wider rolls.** Rolls now cover softer and darker colours too, but never a muddy grey or a black you can't see (the rare near-black stays its own thing).
- **Wild ghouls get colours of their own.** Each wild ghoul's wings or tails come in a colour picked from the seed it was born with, so it's the same every time you meet it. About 1 in 7 still have the classic crimson.
- Companions (Touka's wings) keep their own colours.

Untested in game: compiled, unit tested and the wing palettes checked in offline renders only. Try: on the Ukaku path, `/kagune color reroll` with your wings out, both forms, and fire some shards; meet a few wild ghouls (`/kagune npc ...`).
